about: Character art made with Higgsfield (model gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, resolution 1k, background transparent: 0.5 credits an image). Each request is one image; tools/import_generated.py cuts it into the named sprites, matching figures to outputs left to right. refs are the reference images given to the model, in order.

references.ref_bodies: npc_walt, npc_maya and player_idle side by side on white: style, proportions and pose
references.ref_faces: face_walt_neutral, face_maya_content and face_june_gentle side by side on white: portrait style and framing
references.<name>_body: the generated full-body image of that character: keeps the portraits consistent with the sprite
references.ref_items: item_coffee_mug, item_teacup, item_picnic_basket, item_camera and item_novel side by side on white: item style

style: See the prompts: every request asks for the game's hand-painted style (ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading) and a transparent background.

requests.prompt: A new character for the same 2D game as the reference image, drawn in exactly the same hand-painted style as the reference characters: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle speckles, warm muted palette, the same semi-realistic proportions, head size and line weight. One single character only, full body from the top of the head down to the shoes, centred, standing relaxed in a three-quarter view with the body and face turned slightly towards the viewer's right, arms at the sides, like the reference poses. The character: Luis Delgado, a warm Latino corner-store owner in his mid 60s, stocky build, grey swept-back hair, thick grey moustache, deep smile lines, blue plaid flannel shirt with the sleeves rolled up under a faded olive-green canvas shop apron, brown work trousers, worn black work shoes, a pencil tucked behind one ear. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text.
